create.name: Eva Payne
create.bio:
Eva Payne is an American author, retreat leader and meditation guide whose work centres on what she calls living in flow. She holds a master's degree in leadership and management and has studied the idea of flow since 2015, a path she says began during a hard stretch of her own life. Long before that, in 1998, she founded a non-profit summer camp for children and teenagers affected by HIV or AIDS, and she has spoken from stages since her late teens, first as co-host of a local morning show and later at school assemblies.

She is the mother of six and runs Flow Life from Colorado. Her two books, The Flow Life Funnel and The Magic in Flow, set out principles for turning inner wishes into outward choices, built around her own acronyms for love, self, fear and flow. She offers coaching through discovery calls, an online community on Skool with short grounding and breath practices, and talks on courage, intuition and mindfulness. She also hosts the podcast Ideas To Human Better, whose episodes range from life after death to synchronicity. In recent years she has added plant-medicine work, and her Flow Life Retreat is now the main focus of her site.

no_public_base: Her site footer gives only 'Flow Life, Colorado, USA'; no town is published. Recent short videos promote events in Los Angeles and a retreat in Joshua Tree.
